label: TP
reason: User-supplied HTTP header names (via getHeaderNames/getHeaders) flow directly into the response writer via concatenation without any HTML encoding or validation. The CodeQL report correctly identifies two paths: header name ('name') and header value ('value') reaching the sink. Since these inputs are untrusted and unsanitized, they constitute a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: Header name/value sourced from request and written to response without encoding
